description: This Java class 'AuthorizedSubjectsEnforcer' implements an enforcer that manages access permissions for authorized subjects within a security context, providing methods to check permissions and retrieve subject information.

classes.name: AuthorizedSubjectsEnforcer
classes.description: A final class that enforces authorization rules based on a set of authorized subjects, implementing the Enforcer interface.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the authorization context has unrestricted permissions for a given resource and permissions, based on the subjects in the context.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns the set of subject IDs with permissions for a resource, based on the current authorization context.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves the subjects with permissions for a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Obtains subject IDs that have partial permissions for a resource.

methods.name: hasPartialPermissions
methods.description: Determines if there are partial permissions for a resource within the given context and permissions.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Constructs a JSON view of the resource, including fields if permissions are unrestricted.
